settle.method: poll loader.entries() for non-ACTIVE non-disabled entries, excluding this probe row
settle.note: loader.await() is NOT used: it waits on this probe's own fiber inertia and would deadlock.

autoGeneratedIdRows.why: vendor/loader/src/config/tree.ts:54 assigns `options.id = Math.random().toString(16).slice(2, 10)` to any row that declares no id, so these ids differ on every boot. They are keyed by MODULE in the digest, and the raw ids are recorded here rather than discarded, so the substitution is visible. The rows are NOT dropped: their presence and activation are real facts this digest must cover.
